A Lochside Sauna Commission

A bespoke barrel sauna built on site at your holiday home in Scotland, with a full flat glass front facing the water, a hot tub alongside, and a covered structure to hold it.

Every part of this commission is handmade to order by our team in Wales and assembled at your property, so the arrangement is shaped around your setting rather than delivered to it. The sauna is positioned for the view, the hot tub sits under its own cover beside it, and the whole installation stands on one continuous base.

Built on site, facing the water

The Sauna

A 4.5 metre bespoke barrel with the entire front face in flat glass, so the view of the loch is the fourth wall of the sauna.

You enter through a separate changing room, a cooler space to undress, hang towels and settle before the heat. Through the partition, the main chamber runs u-shaped seating with a floating bench along the glass, so everyone sits facing the water. The heater sits to the left as you walk in: a 9 kW Wi-Fi controlled Harvia Cilindro carrying 90 kg of volcanic stones, run from a three phase supply and switched on from your phone before you arrive.

The barrel is built from 47 mm treated thermowood with a shingled roof laid over a ventilated frame, and heat resistant ambient LED lighting is fitted through the interior. Because it is assembled on site by our team rather than craned in, the build works with your ground and your setting.
